_comment: shovel_dirt: two-handed tool. `two_hand` runs the shaft axis between both grip
links so it tracks the hands as their relative pose drifts (0.138 m over the clip).
grip_offset is DELIBERATELY ABSENT here. Setting it to [0.127,0,-0.027] (the eef_L
pocket) is anatomically correct but puts the 2.5 kg shovel on a 0.13 m lever arm,
which an open end-effector cannot hold: contact-loss rate went 0.0019 -> 0.0150 per
step and episode length 137.8 -> 40.5. See runs iqaq9t50 (eef_L) and 23-02-28.
Re-enable grip_offset once a dedicated hand CAPTURES the shaft rather than resting
it. Set it to the centre of that hand's collar, then re-derive axis_offset and both
contact offsets from the resulting grip span (scripts in pipeline/, see README 5).
